text:
Situation: Protamine sulfate has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-04-20 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 293 vials (31.1 days); Corvale General holds 160 vials (14.9 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows protamine sulfate listed continuously from 2021-04-20 through 2026-10-21. Our product label identifies Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1123748 at that plant ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-05-22. That OAI inspection occurred 337 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2021-04-20. A later FDA inspection 1174894 at the same plant ended 2022-06-30 and was also classified OAI, with classification letter dated 2024-04-30. The most recent inspection 1216183 ended 2023-08-24 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly two to four weeks depending on site. The rule-based best option is to buy from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer confirms receipt and allocates stock to Corvale East and Corvale General; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list weekly and reports status changes; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting resolution at the Fresenius Kabi plant.
